_doc: Manual identity links. '*' maps a normalised base from any namespace to a canonical model_id. Every entry needs a reason; never add a guess.

hailuo-3-max.reason: OpenRouter minimax/hailuo-3-max = AA 'MiniMax H3 Max' (Hailuo is MiniMax's video brand; same vendor, same version)

grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview.reason: Kie 'grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview' = AA/OpenRouter grok-imagine-video-1.5 (same version, Kie labels it preview)

gemini-omni-1-1-flash.reason: Arena 'gemini-omni-1.1-flash' = AA/Kie Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 (same model, Arena orders the words differently; Google blog link on Arena confirms)

grok-imagine-video-1.5-agent.reason: Arena row of Grok Imagine Video 1.5 driven by its agent mode (co-release); same model, different generation mode
